task: Deliver Phase 3G authenticated private attachment read as a separate API PR stacked on PR #45.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/files/:id requires a valid Token JWT and resolves its username subject to the user's UUID before checking attachment ownership.
Only the owning user can read an attachment; missing and foreign attachments return the same non-disclosing 404.
Private file reads stay below the configured private storage root and reject unsupported image metadata, invalid size metadata, missing files, and size mismatches without exposing storage paths.
Successful reads return the supported image media type and content length with private no-store, no-cache, and nosniff headers.
The API has focused unit, storage, and E2E coverage, a passing build, zero-error lint, and an independent final review.
blastRadius: HTTP image response headers and content type
contracts: non-disclosing 404 for missing or foreign attachments
